signed_split.description: For bge_m3 representation, weighted Jaccard and Dice are computed on X_overlap = [max(X,0) | max(-X,0)] — concatenation of positive and negative parts. This ensures all components are non-negative, guaranteeing values in [0,1].

methodology.other_metrics: cosine, pearson, spearman, and all distance metrics are computed on the original X_dense for all representations.

edge_cases.note_zero_vectors: cosine/jaccard/dice/pearson/spearman = 0 for distinct zero/constant vectors; diagonal = 1
edge_cases.note_empty_bge: BGE-M3 model is not loaded when the corpus is empty
edge_cases.note_empty_representation: For (N,0) representations: all distances = 0, similarities for i != j = 0, diagonal = 1
edge_cases.note_quality_summary: When intra/inter pairs are absent or AUC/AP undefined: mean = 0, AUC/AP = 0.5, reason noted in 'note' column
